targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", endpoint AS metric, (metrics->>'load_ms')::float AS value FROM measurement WHERE workload='web' AND ok AND metrics->>'load_ms' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1

SELECT ts AS "time", endpoint AS metric, (metrics->>'startup_ms')::float AS value FROM measurement WHERE workload='video' AND ok AND metrics->>'startup_ms' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Video rebuffer time

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", endpoint AS metric, (metrics->>'rebuffer_ms')::float AS value FROM measurement WHERE workload='video' AND ok AND metrics->>'rebuffer_ms' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Stays flat at zero while delivery exceeds the media bitrate. The headroom panel is the continuous form of the same question; this one fires under fault injection.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", endpoint AS metric, (metrics->>'fetch_ms')::float AS value FROM measurement WHERE workload='email' AND ok AND metrics->>'fetch_ms' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1

SELECT ts AS "time", endpoint AS metric, (metrics->>'throughput_mbps')::float AS value FROM measurement WHERE workload='download' AND ok AND metrics->>'throughput_mbps' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Baseline RTT (median + p95 per interval)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, $__interval), target || ' p50' AS metric, percentile_cont(0.5) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (metrics->>'rtt_ms')::float) AS value FROM measurement WHERE workload='baseline' AND ok AND metrics->>'rtt_ms' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, $__interval), target || ' p95' AS metric, percentile_cont(0.95) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY (metrics->>'rtt_ms')::float) AS value FROM measurement WHERE workload='baseline' AND ok AND metrics->>'rtt_ms' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Minimum interval 10m: smaller buckets hold too few runs to average the per-run quantisation away.

panels.title: Baseline packet loss (mean per interval)

targets.rawSql: SELECT $__timeGroupAlias(ts, $__interval), target AS metric, avg((metrics->>'loss_pct')::float) AS value FROM measurement WHERE workload='baseline' AND ok AND metrics->>'loss_pct' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) GROUP BY 1, 2 ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Per-run loss_pct is quantised by the packet count (one lost packet of five reads as 20%). Averaging over the interval recovers the real loss rate. Minimum interval 15m: smaller buckets hold too few runs to average the per-run quantisation away.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", target AS metric, (metrics->>'dest_rtt_ms')::float AS value FROM measurement WHERE workload='path' AND ok AND metrics->>'dest_rtt_ms' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Video delivery headroom (x real time)
panels.description: Delivery rate divided by media bitrate. 1.0 means playback is on the edge of stalling; higher is more margin before a rebuffer.

targets.rawSql: SELECT ts AS "time", endpoint AS metric, (metrics->>'headroom_x')::float AS value FROM measurement WHERE workload='video' AND ok AND metrics->>'headroom_x' IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(ts) ORDER BY 1
